answer:
Based on the **Times Higher Education (THE) World University Rankings 2023**, the following United States universities are ranked **#10 to #70**, have at least **20,000 FTE students**, at least **25% international students**, and are located in a city with a population of at least **300,000** (based on 2023 US Census estimates):

1.  **Columbia University** (Ranked #11) – New York City, NY
2.  **University of Chicago** (Ranked #13) – Chicago, IL
3.  **University of Pennsylvania** (Ranked #14) – Philadelphia, PA
4.  **Johns Hopkins University** (Ranked #15) – Baltimore, MD
5.  **University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA)** (Ranked #21) – Los Angeles, CA
6.  **New York University (NYU)** (Ranked #24) – New York City, NY
7.  **University of Washington** (Ranked #26) – Seattle, WA
8.  **Carnegie Mellon University** (Ranked #28) – Pittsburgh, PA (Population ~302k)
9.  **University of California, San Diego (UCSD)** (Ranked #32) – San Diego, CA
10. **Tulane University** (Ranked ~40) – New Orleans, LA
11. **Georgia Institute of Technology** (Ranked ~44) – Atlanta, GA
12. **The Ohio State University** (Ranked ~49) – Columbus, OH
13. **Emory University** (Ranked ~50) – Atlanta, GA
14. **Rice University** (Ranked ~50) – Houston, TX
15. **University of Southern California (USC)** (Ranked ~58) – Los Angeles, CA
16. **University of Minnesota** (Ranked ~62) – Minneapolis, MN
17. **University of New Mexico** (Ranked ~63) – Albuquerque, NM
18. **University of Nevada, Las Vegas (UNLV)** (Ranked ~65) – Las Vegas, NV
19. **Case Western Reserve University** (Ranked ~66) – Cleveland, OH

*Note: Many other highly ranked US universities (e.g., Cornell, Duke, Northwestern, UNC Chapel Hill, University of Florida, Texas A&M) were excluded because they are located in cities with populations under 300,000 (such as Ithaca, Durham, Evanston, Chapel Hill, Gainesville, College Station). Boston University was ranked approximately #72 in 2023, placing it just outside the #70 threshold.*
